seo.title: Sayed Zaid & Zikra Shaikh - Nikah
seo.description: The Sayed family invites you to the Nikah of Sayed Zaid and Zikra Shaikh on Tuesday, 1 December 2026, at Kokni Hall, Mumbai.

headline: By the grace of Almighty Allah

groom.name: Sayed Zaid
groom.details: Son of Mrs. & Mr. Sayed Shoaib Nazir

bride.name: Zikra Shaikh
bride.details: Daughter of Mrs. & Mr. Afzal Shaikh

verse.translation: And He placed between you affection and mercy.

event.title: Nikah of Sayed Zaid & Zikra Shaikh

venue.name: Kokni Hall
venue.mapQuery: Kokni Community Hall, Jehangir Boman Behram Road, Mumbai Central, Mumbai

duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.translation: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
Please keep the couple in your duas.

gifts: Your presence, duas and blessings are the greatest gifts we could ask for.

closing.message: We look forward to celebrating with you.
